evidence: Finding 1: interface.md says monthlyReport merely validates `YYYY-MM`, while acceptance.cjs explicitly requires `2026-13` and `2026-9` to fail. A regex-only implementation could accept month 13. Smallest correction: require exactly four digits, a hyphen, and month 01 through 12.

Finding 2: interface.md provides function signatures but does not state whether parseImportCsv, readLedger, mergeRecords, writeLedgerAtomic, and monthlyReport are synchronous or Promise-based. Primary owns cli.cjs and must wire these worker-owned APIs. Smallest correction: declare all listed APIs synchronous, or explicitly declare Promise returns.

Finding 3: interface.md requires rejecting bad column counts but does not define whether a final LF/CRLF creates an empty record. acceptance.cjs supplies header-only and data CSVs ending in a newline, so treating the terminal separator as a blank row would reject valid fixtures. Smallest correction: state that one final record terminator does not create an additional row, while actual blank records remain malformed.

Ownership evidence: .ultra/contexts/task-expense-ledger.md and interface.md assign Worker left only `src/import/**` plus exact file `src/money.cjs`, Worker right only `src/ledger/**`, and Primary `cli.cjs`, README.md, integration checks, integration, and canonical records. No writable-path collision is present.
